claims.title: Extension-Heavy Benchmark Peer Claim Bundle
claims.claim_summary: Node/Bun comparative benchmark claims can be rerun by independent parties through a neutral verifier surface.
claims.replication_gap: This lane remains non-replicated until an external verifier reruns the published bundle and records an equivalent verdict.

claims.title: Security Enforcement Independent Verification Bundle
claims.claim_summary: Capability, IFC, and containment claims can be rerun by third parties from deterministic verifier-facing artifacts.
claims.replication_gap: This lane remains non-replicated until an external verifier reruns the adversarial bundle and publishes equivalent containment verdicts.

claims.title: Runtime Replay and Receipt Verification Bundle
claims.claim_summary: Deterministic runtime and replay claims can be independently rerun from receipt-linked bundles without project-private context.
claims.replication_gap: This lane remains non-replicated until a third party reruns the replay bundle and confirms the published verdicts.
